name: China Resources Chemical Innovative Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: China Resources Chemical Innovative Materials Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of bottle-grade polyester chips in China and internationally. It offers polyester bottle flakes. The company is also involved in chemical raw materials and products wholesale; and research and experimental development activities. Its products are used in drinking water, carbonated beverage, hot-fill beverage, and edible oil bottles, as well as condiment packaging, cold drink cups, fruit and vegetable boxes, and other food and non-food packaging applications.
